presentationRules: Business calculations belong outside Vue presentation components.
Loan calculations belong in the domain/application layers, not loan presentation.
Future-scope modules must not be treated as required current-scope UI capabilities.
Historical Entries must expose its save-request contract.
Required admin-child modules must be represented under their declared Admin parent and are not primary driver navigation destinations.
Settings may expose only currently implemented theme, local backup, local restore, reset and about behavior.
Future capabilities remain architecture-ready but must not appear as buttons, switches or other controls until their contracts and implementations are activated.
